blogs.title: Why Angles Matter: The Secret Behind Orthogonal Finetuning for Diffusion Models
blogs.description: An accessible deep‑dive into the core insight of the paper – that the directions (angles) of neurons encode most of the semantic knowledge in text‑to‑image diffusion models. The post explains hyperspherical energy, shows the toy auto‑encoder experiment, and uses analogies like phase vs. magnitude in Fourier transforms to illustrate why rotating neurons preserves generation quality.

blogs.title: From DreamBooth to OFT: A New Way to Teach Diffusion Models Your Personal Subject
blogs.description: Explains how Orthogonal Finetuning (and its constrained variant COFT) improves subject‑driven generation. Covers the limitations of traditional DreamBooth and LoRA, walks through the finetuning process with orthogonal matrices, and highlights empirical gains in stability, convergence speed, and identity preservation with easy‑to‑understand visual examples.

blogs.title: Controlling Images with No Extra Overhead: OFT vs. ControlNet & T2I‑Adapter
blogs.description: Breaks down how OFT achieves precise controllable generation (Canny edges, segmentation maps, facial landmarks) without adding extra network branches. The article compares training efficiency, parameter count, and the new "control consistency" metric introduced in the paper, showing why OFT converges faster and produces sharper results.

blogs.title: The Math Made Simple: How Orthogonal Transformations Preserve Hyperspherical Energy
blogs.description: Translates the technical proofs of hyperspherical energy invariance into a story for non‑experts. Includes intuitive graphics of points on a sphere, explains Cayley parameterization and block‑diagonal tricks, and clarifies why keeping pairwise neuron angles unchanged is a robust regularizer for finetuning.

blogs.title: Practical Guide: Adding Orthogonal Finetuning to Your Own Diffusion Pipeline
blogs.description: Step‑by‑step tutorial for developers who want to try OFT/COFT on Stable Diffusion or other diffusion models. Covers code snippets for initializing orthogonal matrices, using Cayley transforms, setting the ε‑radius in COFT, and tips for hyperparameter tuning based on the paper’s experiments.
